prompt: A pencil sketch with light color wash depicts a quiet airport gate. On the left, a woman in a blue coat sits on a metal bench, her posture relaxed as she waits. In the center, a silver suitcase stands upright next to her, its handle extended. The woman is looking at the silver suitcase, creating a moment of stillness before departure. There is no crowd in the background, keeping the focus entirely on these two elements. The soft wash adds a gentle tone to the graphite lines, highlighting the texture of the coat and the metallic sheen of the luggage without distracting from the simple composition.
